newsitem.title: MACEDONIA: SOCCER-MACEDONIA BEAT IRISH 3-2 IN BAD-TEMPERED CLASH.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-MACEDONIA BEAT IRISH 3-2 IN BAD-TEMPERED CLASH.

text.p: Macedonia beat the Republic of Ireland 3-2 in a bad-tempered World Cup European group eight qualifying match on Wednesday.

In injury time both sides had a player sent off. Ireland's Jason McAteer was dismissed for apparently striking out at an opponent with his knee while Macedonia's two-goal hero Mitko Stojkovski was sent off for retaliating.
The Irish had taken the lead in the eighth minute through Alan McLoughlin but then gave away two penalties before halftime.
McAteer and Terry Phelan were both judged to have handled the ball in the penalty area and Stojkovski twice scored from the spot.
The second half was dominated by Macedonia who were cheered on by some 10,000 home fans.
They took a 3-1 lead on the hour through Goce Hristov and, although Irish substitute David Kelly pulled a goal back in the 78th minute, Macedonia held on for their finest World Cup victory to date.
